senses.gloss:
bhaṭṭāra, m. lord. [a transition-stem
(399) fr. bhartṛ: corresponding to the
strong acc. s. form bhartār-am, taken as
if it were bhartāra-m, is made the nom.
s. bhartāra-s, etc.; both transition to
the a-declension, and assimilation of rt
to ṭṭ are regular in Prakrit.]

bhaṭṭāraka, m. lord, applied to gods
and learned men. [bhaṭṭāra, 1222c 1.]
